candidates.statement: Order service's PostgreSQL connection pool is exhausted: order traces show postgres.acquire_connection ERROR at 1350ms, order logs show 7 db_pool_acquire_timeout errors (503), and order metrics show 24 db_pool_waiters with p95 1100ms, while payment and inventory pools show 0 waiters and low latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No pool size/max-connection config or postgres-side saturation metrics; cause of pool exhaustion (leak vs load) not established.

report.explanation: Order service is the only component with pool waiters (24), acquire timeouts in logs and traces, and elevated p95 (1100ms); payment and inventory are healthy with 0 waiters and 75ms p95. Deployment records are old (725/485 min) and do not establish causation. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion on order.
